security_findings.finding: BuyButton (web/src/app/(marketing)/pricing/buy-button.tsx) was NOT migrated to the new design-token system: its button used `bg-foreground text-background` (legacy Geist boilerplate vars, not ink-900/terracotta-600) and its error text used hardcoded `text-red-600` instead of the Alert component. Fixed in a follow-up dispatch: BuyButton now accepts a variant prop and uses Alert.
security_findings.scenario: A future edit to BuyButton could silently break the Pro-card color override that relied on a `[&_button]:...` descendant-selector hack, with no compile error or test failure.

security_findings.finding: The hero illustration's directional SVG arrow in web/src/app/(marketing)/page.tsx used `className="text-terracotta-600"` directly, violating the project's own rule that terracotta-600 is only used as a button background (text-safe variant is terracotta-700). Fixed in the same follow-up dispatch.
security_findings.scenario: Not a WCAG failure (graphical element, 3:1 threshold met), but a project-convention violation that could be miscategorized by a future reviewer grepping for the token.

approved_points: Old-location files (page.tsx, pricing/, login/, signup/) genuinely deleted, no duplicate-route risk.
(marketing)/layout.tsx only wraps the 4 public pages, root layout unaffected — admin/agent pages correctly isolated (AC-10).
login/actions.ts and signup/actions.ts byte-for-byte identical to pre-move versions — server action behavior unchanged.
Real <label htmlFor> elements present and correctly bound on all login/signup inputs with correct autoComplete values (AC-7).
Alert component correctly renders role="alert"/role="status" in the DOM (AC-3/AC-4/AC-5).
Color tokens in globals.css match design-direction.md's documented hex values exactly.
overall_assessment: The page migration (route-group isolation, deleted old routes, untouched server actions, label/role/token usage) is solid and matches atdd.md/design-direction.md closely. Both low-severity findings were fixed and independently re-verified (tsc clean, 164/164 tests pass, build passes on Next.js 16.4.3 after a stale node_modules fix, live browser confirmation of Pro-card inverse styling).
